text: {"label":"Pavlovian Conditioning and Conditioned Reinforcement","definition":"Basic, translational, and conceptual work on respondent (Pavlovian) conditioning processes such as blocking, occasion setting, higher-order conditioning, and conditioned inhibition, and how stimulus pairing establishes conditioned reinforcers.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on stimulus–stimulus pairing and respondent processes that give stimuli value, not on discriminative stimulus control, response–reinforcer contingencies, or formation of equivalence classes."}
